# Shellback: a slow, heavy cave tortoise 1.3 m long: a domed stone shell with a mossy crown, a dark
# rim, four stubby legs, a horned head. Origin: on the floor under the shell. Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Shell --base-color 0.4275 0.4471 0.4392 --no-slot
material new Rim --base-color 0.1451 0.1647 0.1765 --no-slot
material new Moss --base-color 0.5176 0.5882 0.4824 --no-slot
material new Skin --base-color 0.4118 0.5137 0.3647 --no-slot
material new Horn --base-color 0.7020 0.7647 0.5725 --no-slot
material new Eye --base-color 0.7020 0.7647 0.5725 --no-slot
add mesh cone --name Shell --vertices 8 --radius1 0.58 --radius2 0.3 --depth 0.42 --location 0 0.05 0.5
set rotation 0 0 22.5
apply --rotation
material assign Shell
add mesh cylinder --name Crown --vertices 8 --radius 0.3 --depth 0.09 --location 0 0.05 0.75
set rotation 0 0 22.5
apply --rotation
material assign Moss
add mesh cylinder --name Rim --vertices 8 --radius 0.64 --depth 0.12 --location 0 0.05 0.25
set rotation 0 0 22.5
apply --rotation
material assign Rim
add mesh cube --name LegFR --size 1 --location -0.380 -0.300 0.100
scale 0.220 0.220 0.200
apply --scale
material assign Skin
add mesh cube --name LegFL --size 1 --location 0.380 -0.300 0.100
scale 0.220 0.220 0.200
apply --scale
material assign Skin
add mesh cube --name LegBR --size 1 --location -0.380 0.400 0.100
scale 0.220 0.220 0.200
apply --scale
material assign Skin
add mesh cube --name LegBL --size 1 --location 0.380 0.400 0.100
scale 0.220 0.220 0.200
apply --scale
material assign Skin
add mesh cube --name Head --size 1 --location 0.000 -0.660 0.300
scale 0.320 0.280 0.260
apply --scale
material assign Skin
add mesh cone --name HornR --vertices 4 --radius1 0.06 --radius2 0.0 --depth 0.2 --location -0.12 -0.7 0.5
material assign Horn
add mesh cone --name HornL --vertices 4 --radius1 0.06 --radius2 0.0 --depth 0.2 --location 0.12 -0.7 0.5
material assign Horn
add mesh cube --name EyeR --size 1 --location -0.090 -0.800 0.340
scale 0.070 0.040 0.060
apply --scale
material assign Eye
add mesh cube --name EyeL --size 1 --location 0.090 -0.800 0.340
scale 0.070 0.040 0.060
apply --scale
material assign Eye
select all
shade flat
export shellback.glb
